text:
Riley (People Ops): Quick ask 12:00 drop-off: our guest (Alex from Harmonica Studios) is bringing a cello in a hard case + a small boxed cake for the team. They said theyll be here around 11:50. Can we take packages at the lobby and stash the cello somewhere secure while they rehearse?
Sam (Front Desk): We can accept at the main desk. Do they need a courier badge or will the courier leave after drop?
Riley (People Ops): Courier leaves right after drop. Need a courier badge but no access beyond lobby. Guest will need a day visitor badge and access to Meeting Room B for a 30-min run-through.
Priya (Design): Meeting Room B is free at 12:00-12:30. Ill block it. Also cake 1 fruit/vegan? Need fridge space?
Riley (People Ops): Cake is vegan chocolate. Might need fridge for later; can we save a shelf?
Noah (Eng): I can clear a shelf in the staff fridge. Also happy to help carry the cello if they need.
Jamal (Facilities): Secure storage options: Locker F near the loading bay is good for tall hard cases (upright). If it's too wide they can lay flat on a padded pallet. Ill bring padding.
Sam (Front Desk): badge printer health: online, color OK but slow. frontdesk-bot: visitor pre-check: https://ops.company/checkin?token=vis1967
Riley (People Ops): Please do b/w badge for courier, color for guest if they want. Tagging volunteers to help unload: react with :hand: below.
Noah (Eng): :hand: Ill be at the lobby at 11:45.
Priya (Design): :hand: Ill help move the cake into the kitchen and set plates.
Sam (Front Desk): Reminder to ask for ID at check-in. Also Courier badge rule: no elevator access.
Riley (People Ops): Noted. Use this fallback command if badge printer stalls: `lp -d badge_printer visitor_tag.pdf`.
Jamal (Facilities): Bringing dolly and two foam pads, will meet at 11:50.
Sam (Front Desk): If anything unusual (big case or damage) Ill escalate to #people-ops.
Riley (People Ops): Thanks all 1 Ill confirm if arrival time shifts. Cake emoji :cake:
